results.title: Les Mousses
results.overview: In the playground, the boys monopolize the space and the soccer field. But a group of girls, "Les Mousses," has a plan to remedy this.

results.title: A Song
results.overview: Music teacher Noel is reunited briefly with his estranged mother during a local trad session. He must navigate his complicated past alongside his connection with new-found love, James.

results.title: Procedure
results.overview: Murat, who has just been imprisoned, asks for a request to his wife Sema, which is against the procedures. Sema cannot stand her husband's pressure and tries to get Murat's request into the prison by illegal means. But the prison has excessive precautions.

results.title: Pointes For My Mom
results.overview: A 15-year-old girl nicknamed Krysya with Asperger's syndrome lived in a tent at a reindeer herders' camp in the tundra until she was seven. Krysya is selected to a ballet boarding school in Vologda. As in elementary school, her classmates do not like her, not understanding her illness. Krysya has a big dream - to become a famous ballerina.

results.title: I'm the Most Racist Person I Know
results.original_title: I'm the Most Racist Person I Know
results.overview: When a romantic gesture towards a bartender backfires, Lali unexpectedly finds herself offered a pity date by another bartender, Ana. What starts as an awkward encounter turns into a genuine connection as they bond over shared experiences as women of color. As they grow closer, Lali finds herself falling for Ana. But when the conversation takes an unexpected turn, Lali must confront her prejudices towards Ana and... herself.

results.title: The Story of Detective Zhan Zhao
results.overview: In the fourth year of Jiayou in the Northern Song Dynasty, a shocking private salt case was exposed, uncovering a sinister plot involving Zhang Kejiu, the Huainan Transport Commissioner, who colluded with the Liao people in treason. Kaifeng Prefecture's Zhan Zhao was ordered to arrest him. Upon hearing the news, Zhang Kejiu, aided by Liao scouts, fled in haste. A larger confrontation, hidden behind the private salt case, was about to unfold.

results.title: Pentecost Prince
results.overview: The young, charismatic Thomas Fontein is a rising star in the Pentecostal church. When pastor Daniël announces his departure, nothing stands in the way of a glorious future. But when very different choices are made, Thomas falls into a deep crisis of faith that will affect many people.

results.title: Ricordi digitali x cuori in affanno
results.original_title: Ricordi digitali x cuori in affanno
results.overview: Lucia is with her friend Flavia in her car, parked in Matteo's neighborhood. Lucia wants to leave him but doesn't know how; he has intimate videos of their relationship. Flavia encourages her to be as clear and determined as possible, hoping for Matteo's understanding.  When Lucia and Matteo sit down for coffee, not everything goes as planned.

results.title: Little Animals
results.overview: On New Year's Eve, the sisters decide to go back to the past.

results.title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Justin Jefferson
results.original_title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Justin Jefferson
results.overview: Eli Manning sends Vikings star Justin Jefferson undercover as a nature photographer to get the inside scoop on the fast-growing sport of flag football. He’ll snap pics, confuse coaches, break ankles, and soar like the common loon.

results.title: Admission
results.overview: Every parent wants to secure the best possible future for their child. For Sun and Li, that means getting their six-year-old son, Yu, admitted to an elite international school. However, after the interview, whispers of rejection emerge, prompting the couple to meet with their trusted "helpers" – a board member and an admissions agent – in a hotel room to find out who is to blame. As suspicion mounts, hidden motives and quiet frustrations begin to surface, revealing that the school admission process is merely a reflection of deeper anxieties concerning success, security and self-worth.

results.title: Something Blue
results.overview: Lifelong friends Óscar and Eli find themselves in a messy situation after a drunken night leads to unexpected consequences. Forced to replace a ruined wedding dress, they embark on a chaotic journey filled with setbacks and awkward run-ins with their exes.

results.title: Blue Weasel
results.overview: A low-level criminal, leading a double life as a cleaner, finds himself trapped between a dangerous arms dealer and the town's chief of police.

results.title: The Nonsense
results.overview: Yu-na, a level-headed and rational insurance claim adjuster, investigates a questionable death by falling with suspicions of suicide. During her investigation, she meets Soon-kyu, the deceased's elusive guardian. As Yu-na probes further, she begins to question whether Soon-kyu is a mentor or a conman, and her carefully guarded inner world starts to shake.

results.title: Love is Hard
results.overview: A man who believes his marriage is perfect faces a misunderstanding that erupts years of hidden conflicts, ultimately finding true marital harmony through self-change.

results.overview: A young man finds himself in a telephone interference with a stranger. Shortly thereafter, a romantic phone call will turn into a desperate attempt to save her life.
